name: Qwen3-TTS
summary: Different instructions for VoiceDesign and fixed CustomVoice speakers; Base follows its recording.

design.label: VoiceDesign
design.instructions: Qwen VoiceDesign accepts natural-language audible voice descriptions. Keep requested identity traits, accent and delivery. Develop concise compatible intonation and rhythm; no invented persona. A matching description or seed does not guarantee the same voice on another line.

preset.label: CustomVoice preset
preset.instructions: Qwen CustomVoice accepts delivery instructions for a fixed preset. Keep speaker, language and explicit accent unchanged. Expand only compatible phrasing, word emphasis and intonation. Do not add timbre, pitch-range or identity traits.

reference.label: Base reference
reference.reason: Qwen Base has no installed free-text acting instruction path. Its recording/transcript and supported sampling controls remain authoritative.
